findings.title: 01-requirements.md is missing; design has no verified requirements basis
findings.summary: The requirements file does not exist. All NFR references and scope claims are unverifiable.

findings.title: pubspec.yaml is missing 11 of 16 claimed dependencies
findings.summary: equatable, dartz, cached_network_image, video_player, chewie, flutter_pdfview, just_audio, lottie, flutter_animate, intl, get_it, bloc_test, mocktail are all absent. flutter_bloc, go_router, shared_preferences are present but at different versions than stated.

findings.title: Design claims codebase is nearly empty; actual codebase has substantial existing implementation
findings.summary: The project already has 17+ core files, a working AuthBloc, UserModel, AuthService, MockAuthService, AppTheme, AppColors, AppRouter with 9 routes, KG/grades/profile features. The design will collide with all of them.

findings.title: Existing AuthBloc contract is incompatible with design's AuthBloc
findings.summary: Existing AuthBloc takes AuthService, uses UserModel, has different events (AuthCheckRequested/RegisterRequested/LoginRequested/LogoutRequested) and different state names (AuthFailure not AuthError). No migration path is specified.

findings.title: AppConstants missing kidsMaxGrade, middleMaxGrade, tokenKey, refreshTokenKey, userProfileKey, quizTimerWarningThreshold
findings.summary: AppConstants only has appName and appVersion. StorageKeys already exists with token keys but the design ignores it. Numeric values for grade thresholds are never specified.

findings.title: ApiEndpoints missing ~18 endpoints the design relies on
findings.summary: dashboard, chapters, topics, lessons, lessonDetail, reportProgress, practiceQuestions, submitPracticeAttempt, quiz detail, submitQuiz, mockExamDetail, mockExamSubmit, achievements, search, notifications, markNotificationRead, subscription, parentLink are all absent from ApiEndpoints.

findings.title: Existing AssetConstants conflicts with design version; animation asset directories not registered in pubspec.yaml
findings.summary: Existing AssetConstants defines path prefixes only. Design's animation/image constants are new. assets/animations/ and assets/images/ are not declared in pubspec.yaml flutter.assets section.

findings.title: Existing AppRouter is at lib/core/router/app_router.dart with 9 routes; design puts it at lib/app/app_router.dart
findings.summary: Design does not mention deleting or migrating the existing router. The existing routes for KG/grades features are not addressed.

findings.title: Existing GradeLevel is an enum (kg, grade6, grade8, grade12); design's Student.grade is int
findings.summary: No mapping from GradeLevel enum to integer is defined. GradeRoutingBloc expects Student but AuthBloc will emit UserModel. These types are incompatible.

findings.title: lib/features/kids/exam/ domain entities directory is listed as empty in file map
findings.summary: The file map lists an empty entities directory for exam. If Quiz entities are reused, the directory should not appear or should list explicit imports.

findings.title: Design specifies flutter_bloc ^8.1.6 but project has ^9.0.0
findings.summary: Pinning to 8.1.6 would downgrade the existing package. The design must reflect the version already installed.

findings.title: Design's LocalStorage interface conflicts with existing one (saveString vs setString, new token methods)
findings.summary: Existing interface uses setString/getString/remove/clear. Design adds saveToken/getToken/saveRefreshToken/getRefreshToken/clearTokens and renames setString to saveString. SharedPrefsStorage implements existing interface and will not compile against the new one.

findings.title: login_page.dart uses username field; existing AuthService and UserModel use email
findings.location: Section 4 (Authentication), Login Page and Data Layer
findings.summary: Existing AuthService.login requires email parameter. Design introduces username-based login. The credential field must be consistently chosen and all affected types updated.

findings.title: ContentExplorerPage single-page drill-down with URL updates is architecturally ambiguous
findings.summary: Design says one page handles all drill-down levels with context.push updating the URL, but separate child routes exist. It is unspecified whether child route builders reuse the parent BLoC or create new instances.

findings.title: DashboardData imports Subject and Achievement from different feature directories, creating cross-feature domain coupling
findings.summary: DashboardData lives in dashboard domain but references Subject (learning) and Achievement (progress). Cross-feature domain imports are not addressed.

findings.title: ProgressBloc Future.wait error policy is underspecified
findings.summary: Which failure message is used when both calls fail? What happens if fetchProgress succeeds but fetchAchievements fails? Policy for partial success is not defined.

findings.title: QuizBloc Stream.periodic timer tick can fire after BLoC is closed
findings.summary: If close() races with a timer tick, add(QuizTimerTicked(...)) throws StateError. The tick handler must guard with if (!isClosed).

findings.title: PracticeBloc Future.delayed auto-advance is not cancellable on close() or PracticeRetried
findings.summary: Future.delayed cannot be cancelled. If BLoC is closed or practice is retried before 1.5s elapses, add(NextQuestionAdvanced()) fires on closed/reset BLoC. Replace with a Timer field that is cancelled in close() and PracticeRetried.

findings.title: Design's app.dart defines KutaKidsApp but existing file defines KutaApp; existing lib/app.dart is not listed for deletion
findings.summary: The existing lib/app.dart must be explicitly listed as a file to delete in Section 21.

findings.title: SearchBloc _SearchExecuted is private and cannot be added directly in tests as the design claims
findings.summary: Dart's library-scope privacy prevents test files from instantiating _SearchExecuted. The stated testability benefit does not hold. Use fake_async or make the event package-visible.

findings.title: route_guard.dart redirect uses DetermineGradeRouteUseCase but does not specify how it is injected into the closure
findings.summary: The redirect callback is a closure; DetermineGradeRouteUseCase must be either injected into AppRouter or resolved from sl() — this is not specified.

findings.title: LoadingIndicator asset-existence check cannot be done synchronously in Flutter
findings.summary: Flutter cannot check if an asset exists at runtime without an async rootBundle.load try-catch. The design's conditional is not implementable as described.

findings.title: WillPopScope is deprecated; only PopScope should be referenced
findings.summary: Remove the WillPopScope mention. Specify PopScope(canPop: false, onPopInvokedWithResult: ...) only.

findings.title: PDF temp file downloaded to Directory.systemTemp is never cleaned up
findings.summary: Each lesson view creates a new temp file without deleting it on dispose. Add await _tempFile?.delete() in dispose().

findings.title: Notification entity shadows dart:core Notification class
findings.summary: Naming the entity Notification shadows dart:core's Notification. Rename to AppNotification.
